Validation Report

Reading-Frame Check: PASS. The reading frame is perfectly maintained from the ATG start codon of the native anchor through to the payload.

Linker Phasing: PASS. The 30 bp flexible linker (GGTGGTGGTGGTTCTGGTGGTGGTGGTTCT) is perfectly in-frame (+1) bridging the native anchor and the ISC1 payload.

Absence of Internal Stops: PASS. Zero internal premature stop codons were detected in any of the three reading frames.

Terminal TAA Confirmation: PASS. A single TAA stop codon terminates each sequence exactly at the expected C-terminus.
